processing: Least-squares affine carto-to-existing-display-site fit over all seven common corners. Retraced roof bodies use the same inferred aerial-to-carto fit. Weighted body-area containment must reach 98%; never clip or deform roofs. All bodies of a neighbor share one minimum SOURCE-pixel rigid translation, bounded by 15 picking + 5.8623 inverse-projected residual = 20.8623 aerial pixels. Revised lot 7 shift is 5.4482 pixels; lot 9 retains 18.9484; lots 11/12 remain unshifted. Report raw failures as well as estimated placed fractions. No heights, extrusion, shadows or verified wall footprints. Road/sidewalk offsets are computed in source Carto pixels from recorded visual sections: sidewalk 38.4708; schematic lane 125.3290; median 18 estimated. Shared miter joins preserve corner continuity. Legacy public-space polygons are history only, NOT rendered asphalt. No conversion to metric widths or model calibration.
limitations: Parcel polygons and roof outlines are different objects, shown with different styles.
